dialogue.content: worked out the annual cost of something and stopped there.
moved money between two of my own accounts for no clear reason.
checked the statement line by line for once.
had a low balance for a week between paydays. uneventful.
said no to a group thing on cost grounds.
had a large amount sitting there before a planned purchase.
added something to a wishlist instead of buying it.
past about four hundred sitting in the current account the balance stops reading as a limit. below that I feel every purchase against it.
physical, almost. above it the number is just decoration.
paid a small bill early because it was in front of me.
added up what the week actually cost. surprising.
looked up the price of the same thing in three places.
got a notification about a rate change and ignored it.
wrote down what I owe someone so I wouldn't forget.
bought lunch out twice and noticed both times.
cleared a tiny balance just to see it at zero.
the months I stayed inside what I'd planned were the ones where the account looked nearly empty all the way through. the cushioned months I drifted past every single time.
every cushioned month I can find. it's very consistent.
checked the pension statement. understood about half.
found an old account with eleven pounds in it.
declined an upgrade offer over the phone.
